title: Gary Nolan presents his injury research the night before the site visit

tellings.quote: I was actually at the the New Mexico site and we hadn't gone there yet it was the night before and we were all just hanging out having a beer and Gary decided he was going to share his research with us and photos

plain: Diana Pasulka, a scholar who studies religion and UFO beliefs, told podcast host Jesse Michels about a 2016 trip to a site in New Mexico. She says that the night before the group went to the site, while everyone was having a beer, the scientist Garry Nolan decided to share his research and photos of injuries suffered by people who reported strange encounters. She tells it as a first look at the serious science some researchers were quietly doing on the subject.
